title: Nvidia's First Quarter Without Its Founder: $115.8B Revenue #Shorts
description:
Nvidia reported $115.8 billion revenue for Q3 fiscal 2027 (quarter ended 25 Oct 2026), up 103% from a year ago - its first report since the founder resigned as CEO on 12 Nov 2026. Data Center revenue was $107.6 billion; Nvidia guides $130 billion (plus or minus 3%) for Q4. Interim CEO: CFO Colette Kress.

Sources (checked 20 Nov 2026):
- NVIDIA Q3 FY2027 results (8-K / press release, 17 Nov 2026): https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/default.aspx
- NVIDIA CEO transition (8-K, 12 Nov 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000082/nvidiaannouncesceotransiti.htm
- CBS News: https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nvidia-earnings-jensen-huang-colette-kress/
- Yahoo Finance live coverage (FT report on a comeback; CNBC: board not in talks, per a person familiar): https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/live/nvidia-live-updates-interim-ceo-kress-prepares-for-q3-earnings-with-huang-reportedly-planning-comeback-153114076.html

Not investment advice.
This video uses an AI-generated presenter (based on the creator), voice and animations. Facts are from the sources above.
